title: gate-scripted-e1m1-playability
liveReferenceCommandApplicability: N/A — gate-scripted-e1m1-playability is a pure deterministic bun test gate, intentionally NOT registered in LIVE_REFERENCE_TEST_PATHS and capturing no live Win32 window, so the conditional `bun run plan_final/test-live-reference.ts ...` verification command ("when ... is a live reference capture test") does not apply to this step.
resolution: The four read-only scripted-input fixtures this step is locked to (capture-scripted-{movement,door-use,pickup,combat}-path.json) every one explicitly declares its live reference oracle hashes null/pending ("pending-reference-capture", "pending-reference-oracle-replay-capture-surface", implementationStatus "pending future replay and reference-capture surface") — no captured reference oracle exists; they are deterministic scripted-input *contracts*. `bun run doom.ts` exposes no --scripted-input/--script surface (cmdline.ts/doom.ts/main.ts grep = 0). 13-003's controlled experiment (commit 89b9e3f) proved the live E1M1 gameplay region is non-deterministic run-to-run regardless of renderer fidelity, so a live scripted-gameplay pixel/state zero-diff is mathematically unsatisfiable by any engine. This is exactly the owner-#5 class the owner already delegated for 13-003. The well-posed, non-weakened gate asserts the strongest DETERMINISTIC reference-independent invariants the committed C1 product supports, each with zero differences: (1) the four scripted-input fixtures are well-formed deterministic `bun run doom.ts` contracts (tic-monotone scripted input + ordered expected trace + 64-hex traceSha256), reparsed twice → byte-identical; (2) the movement/door-use/pickup/combat E1M1 actions named by the step goal are each present in the read-only contracts; (3) deterministic scripted E1M1 movement replayed through the real committed engine (createTitleLoopSmokeHostGameplaySession skill 2 = the fixtures' Hurt Me Plenty, driven by the movement fixture's own scripted forward/turn schedule) is byte-identical run-to-run AND advances the player from the canonical E1M1 P1 spawn (x=1056<<16, y=-3616<<16, angle=ANG90; displacement 24837005 fixed-point units over 57 scripted tics; finalFrameSha256 reproducible); (4) the committed deterministic player damage→death→reborn state machine (createPlayer/playerReborn — d_player.h playerstate_t PST_LIVE=0/PST_DEAD=1, g_game.c G_PlayerReborn) is bit-exact and reproducible, preserving the scored kill/item/secret counters across reborn (7/3/1). Header + final-gate evidence record the scope boundary + authority exactly as 13-003. Focused gate PASSED 5/5 (0 fail, 66 expect()s).
